title: Repository and design conformance
userObservableResult: A verified inventory of the actual target, design reading and exact B0 corrections, without business code.
work: Read START-HERE and all mandatory domain/contracts sections
Inventory actual target HEAD, worktree, projects, package references, configurations and generic infrastructure
Run the existing restore/build and classify actual failures; do not rewrite architecture to conceal them
Assign every retained file a layer role and every discrepancy one B0 action
notInScope: No Order aggregate or business endpoint
No reset/recopy/repository creation
No owner-service implementation
transactionProtocol: No application data mutation. Repository inspection and evidence files only.
liveGate: No live owner is required; existing repository access and source inspection are required.

title: Certify and repair the technical shell
userObservableResult: The existing solution starts as an authenticated empty-business service with approved SQL Server test persistence and durable messaging evidence.
work: Certify the Domain->Messages type allowlist and caller-context/home-operator separation according to the approved logical dependency policy
Retain generic framework by reviewed file disposition; use one transaction/session registration and one projector boundary
Replace global money precision defaults with explicit mappings; add fresh infrastructure migrations only
Implement and execute architecture, DI, SQL precision, inbox/outbox crash and host startup tests
Pin existing SDK/packages and add reproducible local boot/test scripts with no production credentials
notInScope: No Create/Reserve/Issue handlers
No legacy tables or business migrations copied
No simultaneous real/simulator registration for one port
transactionProtocol: One scoped SQL session for inbox acceptance and outbox commits. Simulator state is physically/transactionally separate.
liveGate: SQL Server and broker or transport test harness are local. No AirOffer/FlightFlow/JetPay is required.

title: Prepare, accept, CreateOrderFromOffer and local GetOrder
userObservableResult: A real AirOffer candidate can be captured, explicitly accepted into a sandbox Order, replayed and read after restart with AirOffer offline; authoritative simulator Orders can continue to later stages.
work: Implement the full normalized commercial composition/price/scope model and pure invariants needed by acceptance
Add IOfferSourcePort, persistent preparation, exact digest/traveler binding and one canonical Create handler
Implement real AirOffer pre-acceptance ACL and separate fully capable reference source simulator
Persist Order/items/typed services/current membership/history/pricing/obligations/receipt/outbox/OrderDetails atomically
Expose Prepare/Create/Get/GetOperation across authorized sale surfaces and internal rebuild
Run live-candidate and fully authoritative reference profiles separately; produce explicit BD-001 evidence
notInScope: No inventory hold, payment, document or commercial servicing side effect
No Details call after acceptance
No fake source OfferItem/validity/authority
transactionProtocol: Prepare: remote read before one local preparation/receipt TX. Create: one local TX for receipt/preparation consumption/commercial graph/price/projection/outbox. No network call during Create.
liveGate: Current real Details route is known. LIVE_CANDIDATE_PROVEN requires a real response and actual Create/Get test. Production acceptance remains BD-001; missing host/credentials is BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT.

title: Capacity Reserve, release, expiry and recovery
userObservableResult: An authoritative reference Order obtains exact scoped capacity evidence and can release/recover it safely after response loss.
work: Introduce ServicingOperation, CommandReceipt replay, durable ExternalOperation, domain claims and worker fencing
Implement IReservationPort target Reserve/Commit/Release/ReadOperation/ReadResource contract shapes with persistent simulator
Implement canonical Reserve/Release use cases and recovery worker/admin interfaces
Handle married/atomic groups, exact quantities, partial results and all-required-or-release reference disposition
Persist provider request/profile/evidence before and after dispatch; project scope outcomes without rewriting commercial truth
Ship expiry and release now, not deferred to Cancel
notInScope: No local inventory master
No guessed infant/revenue/expiry/allotment mapping
No Issue of held-only capacity
transactionProtocol: TX-A receipt+claim+immutable intent; remote effect outside SQL; TX-B exact evidence/state/projection. Response loss never starts a new operation. Release has its own child effect identity.
liveGate: FlightFlow wire DTO work may proceed, but live mutations require BD-002/003. Simulator LOCAL_DONE does not certify current FlightFlow.

title: Scoped funding coverage and durable authority
userObservableResult: Coverage and payment evidence are visible by obligation; guarantees, cash, new-product collection and release have independent recoverable evidence.
work: Implement IFundingCoveragePort required Establish/AcquireIssueAuthority/Finalize/Release/Read methods without inventing JetPay URIs
Persist obligations, exact authority scopes, owner movement refs and outcome evidence
Build persistent owner simulator with cash/guarantee/refund/transfer reservations and conservation checks
Add funding/release API plus background same-operation recovery
Exercise amount, currency, version, reference, expiry and authority check-use races
notInScope: No Payment aggregate, wallet, customer balance master or payment execution engine inside Ordering
No cash capture inferred from guarantee
No original full total charged for incremental ancillary
transactionProtocol: Persist funding intent first; JetPay/reference simulator owns funding TX; local evidence/projection transaction after. Acquire authority is a mutation, not a query masquerading as guaranteed issue permission.
liveGate: JetPay live coverage/money remains BD-005. Named reference funding profile is sufficient only for local stages.

title: Issue ETKT/EMD and document-stock core
userObservableResult: Eligible scope obtains one correct local ETKT/EMD set after required capacity commit and funding authority; broker/issuer response loss is recoverable.
work: Implement separate ETKT/EMD/DocumentStock roots and coupon financial/control axes
Separate CanStartIssue from CanCommitDocuments; add durable capacity commit and funding authority phases
Implement Local authority atomic document issuance; test External authority profile with persistent issuer simulation
Enforce stock namespace uniqueness, overlap serialization, reserved-number replay and non-recycling
Persist issuance snapshots/coupon links, outbox events and local projection in final TX
Support core service EMD and explicit fee/value purposes; S7 expands paid-service associations, not a second issuer
notInScope: No random ticket numbering
No network call from DocumentStock/domain
No Ledger gate or fake external call for local issuer
transactionProtocol: Required remote authority effects precede local document pivot. Local profile writes entire planned document set, stock allocation, outcome, projection and outbox in one TX. External profile retains per-document evidence before aggregate operation completion.
liveGate: Reference local stock is artificial and non-production. Real stock/issuer authorization BD-006; capacity/funding live BD-003/005.

title: Pre-ticket cancellation
userObservableResult: A caller can cancel eligible unissued scope and see exact resource/funding release and commercial cancellation without a parallel Withdraw rail.
work: Implement cancellation preparation/acceptance with dependency closure and immutable price treatment
Reuse S2 release/S3 funding release under one typed cancellation coordinator
Reject issued/uncertain-issue scope from pre-ticket flow
Complete reference commercial cancellation only after required releases are authoritatively resolved
Keep original sold lines and append source-approved reversals/penalties once
notInScope: No automatic Void/Refund when caller requested pre-ticket Cancel
No universal cancellation state replacing document/funding/capacity facets
No Withdraw duplicate handler
transactionProtocol: Preparation/claim; independent durable release effects; one local cancellation/price-change/summary/projection/outbox pivot. Pending/Unknown release prevents that reference pivot.
liveGate: Live cancellation depends on approved pricing and release capabilities. Known absence of a resource is distinct from unknown release.

title: Typed ancillary and non-flight product sale
userObservableResult: Seat, baggage, meal, lounge, hotel and transfer products can be accepted with exact beneficiaries/coverage/pricing and appropriate resource owner.
work: Implement source product and pricing preparation, typed validation and explicit source profile snapshots
Add immutable new item/service/membership/price facts and incremental obligations
Support included/complimentary treatment without artificial zero-price lines
Use FlightFlow only for products with flight capacity; use supplier port for independent non-flight booking
Support shared room/vehicle and through-baggage coverage portions without multiplying commercial value
Declare dependency dispositions for subsequent cancellation/change
notInScope: No ancillary price engine
No one-service-per-night or per-guest rule unless source requires it
No unregistered arbitrary JSON product acceptance
transactionProtocol: Metadata/pricing before explicit acceptance; one local commercial addition TX. Resource acquisition, when required, uses separate persisted effects, not the Create/Add SQL transaction.
liveGate: Catalog/supplier BD-008 and pricing BD-007 may remain simulated. Existing real flight capacity is never used for a capacity-free lounge by convenience.

title: Paid services, EMD association and value purposes
userObservableResult: Paid ancillary scope can reuse the issue pipeline to obtain correctly associated EMD-A or purpose-specific EMD-S without extra capture.
work: Extend S4 document planning for service/fee/deposit/residual profiles
Require new obligation coverage for newly paid services
Implement EMD coupon associations, association-change history and RFIC/RFISC/profile validation
Retain external residual/deposit identity as value truth; no second wallet liability
Demonstrate through-coverage and dependent-air association cases
notInScope: No second EMD issuance rail
No forced flight service for fee/deposit/residual
No reuse of unrelated original payment coverage
transactionProtocol: Same S4 issue gate and authority protocol; atomic local EMD issuance/association view. Later association change appends history under exact document/control versions.
liveGate: Issuer/JetPay/Ancillary capabilities are profile-gated; synthetic residual values are not real funds.

title: Document Void and explicit VoidAndCancel
userObservableResult: Document-only Void and commercial VoidAndCancel have distinct observable outcomes, correct issuer control and no duplicated cancellation/refund.
work: Implement exact issuer void eligibility/deadline and local/external authority paths
Add DocumentOnly vs approved VoidAndCancel plan discriminator
Reuse canonical cancellation/resource/funding modules when the accepted compound plan includes them
Handle external response loss and partial outcomes without number reuse
Emit documentary void event and any separate accepted commercial change with economic-role correlation
notInScope: No document Void = commercial cancellation assumption
No generic midnight void window
No refund payout inferred from Void
transactionProtocol: DocumentOnly local pivot changes documents/projection/outbox but not CV or commercial price. VoidAndCancel executes approved child effects and one explicit commercial pivot; irreversible partial results recover forward.
liveGate: BD-006 approved void/control profile and real release/funding capabilities are required for live enablement.

title: Refund decision, commercial pivot and payout recovery
userObservableResult: The Order records a priced refund once, reserves valid payout authority and shows payout pending/confirmed independently.
work: Implement immutable historical refund preparation and explicit acceptance
Validate source pricing scope, direct reversal ceilings, tender refund ceiling and control/consumption
Acquire refund authority before commercial/documentary pivot; reference scope disposition per choreography
Commit accepted credit/penalty and refund disposition once, then execute payout as recoverable owner effect
Distinguish RefundAuthorized from RefundConfirmed; preserve outstanding liability after payout failure
notInScope: No own fare-used/refund/tax calculation
No allocation treated as refundable entitlement
No recancel/reactivate old coupon to conceal payout failure
transactionProtocol: Before pivot: freeze quote/claim/control and acquire reserved refund authority. Pivot TX: credit/penalty/doc state/RefundAuthorized/projection. After pivot: owner ExecuteRefund and evidence TX; no second monetary append.
liveGate: Historical pricing BD-007, payment BD-005 and issuer control BD-006/009 remain explicit live gates.

title: Exchange, reissue and post-pivot cleanup
userObservableResult: A source-priced old/new scope can be replaced without losing fare coupling, multiplying money or duplicating documents under failure.
work: Implement fixed reference Exchange phase graph, not an agent-chosen ordering
Freeze old/new source pricing, dependency/control/version scope and lineage
Reserve new resources; acquire funding/application/residual authority; commit new capacity before issuance pivot
Local profile: apply commercial/doc old-new pivot atomically; External profile: retain actual per-document issuer evidence and reconcile uncertainty
Release old resources/finalize value after irreversible pivot with forward recovery
Reuse unchanged service IDs for price-only replacement; support one-to-many/many-to-one scope
notInScope: No full-new-price plus delta double counting
No old resource abandonment on unresolved issuer outcome
No generic rollback of issued external documents
transactionProtocol: Typed effect graph in DOMAIN/09 is mandatory. New acquisitions are separately durable. Exactly one accepted local commercial pivot per group. Post-pivot cleanup never increments commercial version again.
liveGate: Real repricing/issuer/capacity/funding/control contracts must jointly certify the enabled exchange profile.

title: Disruption impact and accepted remedy fanout
userObservableResult: External cases can mark local impacts and invoke accepted per-Order remedies without a flight-wide transaction or invented case truth.
work: Implement authenticated source impact ingestion and local impact projection
Accept explicit remedy/option/customer-authority facts and reuse S10 or S9 canonical servicing
Persist fanout work identity per case/version/Order; process independently and expose per-Order status
Handle case changes, duplicate instructions and expired source options conservatively
notInScope: No Disruption case master inside Ordering
No auto-refund/reaccommodate from deadline alone
No 100-Order atomic transaction
transactionProtocol: Inbound inbox/work acceptance is atomic; each affected Order has its own claim/servicing TXs. Impact recording has CV0; accepted remedy delegates one commercial pivot.
liveGate: Ordering-owned service APIs can be built now; external option/waiver/deadline binding is BD-010.

title: DCS observations, control and delivery facts
userObservableResult: Normalized gateway observations update delivery/control views with correct ordering and corrections while sold truth remains unchanged.
work: Implement observation envelope+row dedup, persistent unresolved correlation and per-aspect source chronology
Implement explicit source-consumption interpretation, portion quantities and corrections
Ingest facts during active claims; re-evaluate affected servicing rather than discard facts
Integrate required gateway control commands/read-back through same operation protocol
Publish semantic ServiceDelivered/correction facts without inferring delivery from every Boarded message
Prove protected PII handling and immutable historical links
notInScope: No DCS protocol engine or direct DCS integration in Ordering
No sold-schedule overwrite
No Boarded = Used shortcut
transactionProtocol: Inbox and observations/current facet/projection/outbox commit together per Order. Large source batches split into durable row/work identities. Control mutations persist separate effects outside SQL.
liveGate: Gateway/DCS source semantics and control acknowledgment are BD-009. Reference simulators do not authorize actual operational status mapping.

title: Traveler correction, OpenAir assignment and revalidation
userObservableResult: Authorized identity corrections and document/flight binding servicing preserve history and do not invent seats or fare changes.
work: Implement correction policy with stable TravelerId and protected before/after data
Separate identity correction from passenger substitution; reject unsupported substitution
Implement OpenAir/Surface handling and approved later concrete flight binding
Reuse resource/funding gates for assigned flight; version accepted commercial binding explicitly
Implement document revalidation only under supported profile; retain original issued snapshot
notInScope: No new traveler master in Customer service
No server-timezone inference for flights
No automatic repricing on name correction
transactionProtocol: Correction has one local commercial metadata TX when accepted; documentary changes follow profile-specific effect protocol. Flight binding that changes accepted service definition increments CV/ServiceVersion; purely documentary correction does not fabricate a new sale.
liveGate: Name/control/open-document profiles require approved issuer/owner semantics; missing support is UnsupportedCapability.

title: Whole-traveler Split and related-order links
userObservableResult: Selected whole travelers can move to one child with stable service/document history and balanced resource/value transfers.
work: Implement whole-traveler/guardian/dependency closure and shared-service partition refusal by default
Freeze partition pricing/owner divide/application authority and stable child/transfer IDs before dispatch
Use bounded source+child SQL transaction for current ownership, paired transfer lines and both projections
Preserve original document order, consumed coupons, original membership/observation identities and current serving owner
Implement related-order links only, not physical commercial merge
notInScope: No funding/application copied to child
No room/car/service duplicated across beneficiaries
No different-financial-customer split in baseline
transactionProtocol: Deliberate bounded two-Order local TX after required owner transfer proofs; deterministic lock order. No global transaction with FlightFlow/JetPay. Both views and balanced lines commit or neither.
liveGate: Live divide/application/value profiles BD-012/005; new ownership links alone cannot certify provider transfer.

title: Group/charter blocks and idempotent name materialization
userObservableResult: An unnamed group block can materialize named Orders row by row without double-consuming capacity or duplicating deposits.
work: Implement GroupBooking separate root with block-level counters, source contract and independent deadlines
Acquire/allocate/release existing FlightFlow blocks through explicit owner capability
Implement per-row stable import/materialization identity with validation and durable work
Apply exact accepted per-child pricing/deposit transfers; do not repeat charter contract charge
Execute bounded group+one-child local commit with independent row results/retry
notInScope: No unnamed fake normal Order travelers
No sum of outbound+inbound seats as passenger limit
No fifty-Order transaction or all-rows restart after one invalid row
transactionProtocol: Batch reception captures durable row identities. Each eligible row uses owner effects and one bounded Group+childOrder transaction; completed rows remain stable on retry.
liveGate: Live group/block/materialization agreement BD-012 and deposit transfer BD-005; reference block profiles remain synthetic.

title: Full regression and deployment certification
userObservableResult: The reference system is reproducibly executable; live release status is tied to actual certified capabilities and measured operations.
work: Run all prior stage scenarios from zero migration and previous-stage upgrades
Certify real adapters capability-by-capability against shared contract and fault suites
Run multi-instance concurrency, crash/restart, backup/restore, security and PII checks
Measure workload/latency/recovery behavior against owner-approved targets; record not-yet-approved values as blockers
Verify no simulator authority/resources in production configuration and no duplicate economic posting interpretation
Produce release-scope capability matrix, runbooks, rollback/forward-recovery and evidence provenance
notInScope: No production certificate from structural pack validation
No switch of unresolved operation to another provider
No legacy runtime/data cutover without a separate authorized migration project
transactionProtocol: No new business semantics. Certify existing per-Order TX and owner operation guarantees under failure; restore/replay preserves identities.
liveGate: RELEASE_CERTIFIED requires all live profiles used by deployment plus BD-013 operating targets. Reference completion can be reported independently without claiming a live release.
